newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI buys Illinois Tool unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI buys Illinois Tool unit.

text.p: Heavy engineer Australian National Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it had acquired the National Castings operations of Azon Ltd for A$21.5 million.
Azon is a unit of Illinois Tool Works Inc.
National Castings operates two foundries, located at Welshpool in Perth, Western Australia and Launceston, Tasmania.

The company manufactures custom made castings of up to six tonnes in a wide range of steel and iron grades. It supplies to the mining, quarrying and mineral processing industries, to clay products manufacturers, to cement producers, to the general engineering industry and to machinery and valve manufacturers.
ANI managing director Peter Stancliffe said National Castings was a long established business with a sound reputation.

"The strategic location of the Perth (Western Australia) foundry makes it an excellent acquisition for ANI, allowing for expansion of production apability and improved product range for our existing markets," he said.

"National Castings' Launceston (Tasmania) foundry will further strengthen the Resources and Rail Group's position on the Australian East Coast and increase our customer service coverage to include Tasmania," he said.
